Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run chase! The Afghanistan can be seen getting a pep talk from their skipper before taking to the field. The two umpires are also out in the middle and it will be the duo of Tanzid Hasan and Soumya Sarkar to open the innings for Bangladesh. Fazalhaq Farooqi has the new ball in hand and will look to get some early swing. Let's play...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now, this is by no means going to be an easy chase, Bangladesh haven’t had the best of the times with the bat and Afghanistan have a top bowling lineup. The visitors will be tested but the question is, can they overcome the test? We will find out in a bit. Stay tuned.

The Bangladesh pacers were excellent with the new ball. Mustafizur Rahman, Taskin Ahmed and Shoriful Islam didn’t give away a lot and also picked wickets. Once the ball lost its shine, the ball came on nicely onto the bat and the bowlers seemed less effective. Bangladesh will be disappointed with the spinners who failed to pick a wicket. The pacers though came back strongly in the end to keep Afghanistan below a par score with Taskin and Fizz both ending with four wickets each.

That’s a fine recovery from Afghanistan. Had they been given over 220 when they were 4 down for not a lot, they would have surely taken it. The top order was dismissed inside Powerplay 1 but then Gulbadin Naib and Hashmatullah Shahidi put up a small stand to steady things. Naib fell when he just started to get going but then came the stand which got Afghanistan back into the game. A 100-plus stand between Hashmatullah Shahidi and Mohammad Nabi with both scoring fifties. When they were batting 250 looked possible but wickets towards the end have seen them fall short of that mark but still get to a competitive score thanks to Nangeyalia Kharote and his useful 27 runs from 28 balls.

OUT! RUN OUT! That's it, Bangladesh have finally managed to bundle out Afghanistan but Shoriful Islam is visibly upset and rightly so. Gull and straight from Shoriful, angling in, Kharote squeezes it out towards deep mid-wicket and picks up a single but they want two again and start running. Towhid Hridoy fires in a throw at the bowler's end and Shoriful takes off the bails. Fazalhaq Farooqi is well short and Afghanistan finish with 235 on the board.

Commentary.Commentary: Done and dusted with the pre-match proceedings and it is now time to get the 300th international game at Sharjah underway! The umpires are out in the middle and the players of Bangladesh are spreading out on the field. It will be the debutant Sediqullah Atal to open the innings along with Rahmanullah Gurbaz for Afghanistan. Shoriful Islam has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...

We are just a few minutes away from the start of the match but first, the two sets of players will lineup for their respective national anthems. It will be the national anthem of Bangladesh first followed by that of Afghanistan.

PITCH REPORT - Brian Murgatroyd is pitchside and he says that there is a breeze blowing from West to East and the straight boundaries are long with about 75 meters. Ramiz Raja says that nothing much has changed in Sharjah with regards to the surface in the last 40 years and it is a placid track.

Najmul Hossain Shanto, the skipper of Bangladesh says that the boys are feeling good and ready to go and mentions that it is more about focusing on what they can do best rather than focusing on the opposition. Adds that they have a good batting lineup and Rishad Hossain is someone who has come into the ODI setup after impressing in the T20 World Cup.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the captain of Afghanistan says that they will bat first. The reason for that is the pitch looks good and the ball moves a bit under lights. Adds that Sediqullah Atal is all set to make his debut and have plenty of options in the bowling attack.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Najmul Hossain Shanto (C), Tanzid Hasan, Soumya Sarkar, Towhid Hridoy, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah, Mehidy Hasan, Rishad Hossain, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, Shoriful Islam.

NEWS FLASH - There was news about a couple of Bangladeshi players awaiting their visas and it is now confirmed that fast bowler, Nahid Rana will not take part in the first ODI due to the same issue. Nasum Ahmed was another name that seemed to be awaiting his visa but he has arrived and will be one of Bangladesh's key spinners. Toss is now just a few minutes away.

Bangladesh on the other hand have a fairly experienced side and one that is well-suited to the ODI format. After their iconic red-ball triumph in Pakistan, Bangladesh were handed a couple of Test defeats by India after being completely demolished in the T20 format by the same opposition. This is their chance to regain a bit of lost momentum and the pitches in Sharjah should suit their style of play as well. So, who do you think will come out trumps in the series opener? Afghanistan recently welcomed South Africa on a white-ball tour in the UAE and got a couple of massive wins in the ODI format here in Sharjah as well. Hashmatullah Shahidi will lead the side that features a couple of hopeful debutants in the form of wrist-spinner Sediqullah Atal and pacer Bilal Sami with Mujeeb still out due to injury.
